_source: Annual Report FY25/26 + FY22/23 (Kingfisher plc - cat3-european)

kpis.description_fr: Ventes B&Q (DIY UK & Ireland, leader marché). Plus grande bannière du groupe (31% du CA). 316 magasins. TradePoint pro grew +5.2%.
kpis.description_en: B&Q sales (DIY UK & Ireland, market leader). Largest banner (31% of sales). 316 stores. TradePoint pro grew +5.2%.

kpis.description_fr: Ventes Screwfix (outils pros UK + extension France/Irlande). Bannière en forte croissance, 979 magasins UK + 35 France. Marge supérieure aux DIY.
kpis.description_en: Screwfix sales (pro tools UK + France/Ireland expansion). Strong growth banner, 979 UK stores + 35 France. Higher margin than DIY.

kpis.description_fr: Ventes Castorama (DIY France + Poland). 94 magasins France + Castorama Poland. Restructuration en cours (fermetures magasins).
kpis.description_en: Castorama sales (DIY France + Poland). 94 France stores + Castorama Poland. Restructuring ongoing (store closures).

kpis.description_fr: Ventes Brico Dépôt (entrepôts low-cost France + Iberia). 127 magasins France + Iberia. Marché entrepreneurs et auto-construction.
kpis.description_en: Brico Dépôt sales (low-cost warehouses France + Iberia). 127 France stores + Iberia. Contractor and self-build market.

kpis.description_fr: Ventes Espagne (Brico Dépôt Iberia). Marché en récupération post-Covid. Sensible au cycle immobilier ibérique.
kpis.description_en: Spain sales (Brico Dépôt Iberia). Recovering market post-Covid. Sensitive to Iberian housing cycle.

kpis.description_fr: Part des ventes en ligne (hors Screwfix) sur le CA total. +15pts vs FY19/20 pré-Covid. KPI structurel de digitalisation.
kpis.description_en: Online sales share (excluding Screwfix) of total revenue. +15pts vs FY19/20 pre-Covid. Structural digitalization KPI.

kpis.description_fr: Chiffre d'affaires total Kingfisher (5 bannières + Iberia + Romania). Constant currency +0.2%, mais 4.0% impact négatif consumer DIY UK.
kpis.description_en: Total Kingfisher revenue (5 banners + Iberia + Romania). Constant currency +0.2%, but 4.0% negative DIY consumer UK impact.

notes: Source Annual Report FY25/26 + FY22/23. Kingfisher = leader européen DIY (Do-It-Yourself). Fiscal year ending end January. Bannières : B&Q, Screwfix, Castorama, Brico Dépôt, Iberia. JV Koçtaş Turkey 50%.
